+# Automator
+
+A terminal-based automation manager built in Rust with **automatic trigger support** - like GitHub Actions but for your desktop.
+
+## Features
+
+- **Manual triggers** - Run automations on demand
+- **Cron schedules** - Run at specific times/intervals
+- **File watchers** - Trigger when files change
+- **Battery monitoring** - Trigger on charge state, percentage thresholds
+- **KDE Plasma notifications** - Trigger when notifications arrive (via D-Bus)
+- **System events** - Startup, idle detection, lock/unlock
+- **Edit** automation YAML files in your default editor
+- **Delete** with confirmation
+
+## Building
+
+```bash
+cargo build --release
+```
+
+## Running
+
+```bash
+cargo run --release
+```
+
+## Keyboard Shortcuts
+
+| Key | Action |
+|-----|--------|
+| `↑/↓` or `j/k` | Navigate list |
+| `Enter` | View details / Confirm |
+| `Esc` | Go back / Cancel |
+| `n` | Create new automation |
+| `e` | Edit in default editor |
+| `t` | Trigger/Run automation |
+| `d` | Delete automation |
+| `r` | Refresh list |
+| `q` | Quit |
+| `?` | Toggle help |
+
+## Trigger Types
+
+### Manual
+Run by pressing `t` in the UI.
+
+### Cron
+Standard cron expression (seconds, minutes, hours, day of month, month, day of week):
+```yaml
+triggers:
+  - type: cron
+    expression: "0 */6 * * * *"  # Every 6 hours
+```
+
+### File Watch
+Trigger when files are created, modified, or removed:
+```yaml
+triggers:
+  - type: file_watch
+    paths:
+      - /home/user/Downloads
+      - /home/user/Documents
+    recursive: false
+```
+
+### Battery
+Monitor battery state via `/sys/class/power_supply`:
+```yaml
+triggers:
+  - type: battery
+    condition: below      # below, above, full, low, charging, discharging
+    threshold: 15         # optional percentage
+    charging: false       # optional: only when not charging
+```
+
+### Notifications (KDE Plasma)
+Listen to desktop notifications via D-Bus:
+```yaml
+triggers:
+  - type: notification
+    app_name: "Firefox"   # optional: filter by app
+    contains_text: "done" # optional: filter by text in notification
+```
+
+### System Events
+```yaml
+triggers:
+  - type: system_event
+    event: startup        # startup, idle, lock, unlock
+
+  - type: system_event
+    event: idle
+    timeout_seconds: 300  # trigger after 5 min of inactivity
+```
+
+## Automation Format
+
+```yaml
+id: unique-id
+name: My Automation
+description: What it does
+commands:
+  - name: Step 1
+    command: echo
+    args: ["Hello World"]
+    working_dir: null
+triggers:
+  - type: manual
+  - type: cron
+    expression: "0 0 * * * *"
+created_at: 2026-05-22T00:00:00Z
+last_run: null
+enabled: true
+```
+
+## Storage
+
+Automations are stored as YAML files in:
+- Linux: `~/.local/share/automator/`
+- Fallback: `./automations/`
+

+- **battery-full.yaml** - Alerts when battery reaches 100% while charging
+- **notify-logger.yaml** - Logs all desktop notifications
